(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cells (find-color g 8))
                  (shapes (list (list 1
                                      (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1)))
                                (list 2 (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1)))
                                (list 3 (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 1)))
                                (list 4 (list (list 0 0) (list 1 0) (list 1 1))))))
             (define (placed-at anchor offs)
               (map (lambda (o)
                      (list (+ (fst anchor) (fst o)) (+ (snd anchor) (snd o))))
                    offs))
             (define (remove-cells rem placed)
               (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p placed))) rem))
             (define (try-offsets rem p sh offs)
               (if (empty? offs)
                   #f
                   (let* ((off (fst offs))
                          (anchor (list (- (fst p) (fst off)) (- (snd p) (snd off))))
                          (placed (placed-at anchor (snd sh))))
                     (if (all? (lambda (q) (member? q rem)) placed)
                         (let ((ans (search (remove-cells rem placed))))
                           (if ans
                               (cons (list (fst sh) placed) ans)
                               (try-offsets rem p sh (cdr offs))))
                         (try-offsets rem p sh (cdr offs))))))
             (define (try-shapes rem p ss)
               (if (empty? ss)
                   #f
                   (let ((ans (try-offsets rem p (fst ss) (snd (fst ss)))))
                     (if ans ans (try-shapes rem p (cdr ss))))))
             (define (search rem)
               (if (empty? rem) (list) (try-shapes rem (fst rem) shapes)))
             (let ((pieces (search cells)))
               (if pieces
                   (reduce (lambda (acc piece)
                             (paint-cells acc (snd piece) (fst piece)))
                           (empty-grid h w 0)
                           pieces)
                   g))))))
